contract_constraints.constraint: Data-export rights, termination/transition conditions, and renewal windows govern the migration timeline; migration off the incumbent is a recorded program risk (REG-003).
Per-transaction processor economics and settlement timing affect fee policy and sustainability; require Helene's financial validation.
Azure/infrastructure operating costs and implementation costs are sustainability drivers to be modeled; not yet validated.
Bilingual (EN/FR) and accessibility obligations are mandatory for a national Canadian NSO and constrain every stakeholder-facing surface.
Canadian privacy obligations govern personal data (participants, identities); security and data-residency requirements constrain hosting and integration.
A named pilot PTSO/club cohort is a Volume 0 condition; national rollout depends on pilot acceptance and migration readiness.
Curling I/O, Sideline Learning, accreditation, accounting, and payment APIs must provide the flows the target depends on; availability is a VENDOR_CLAIM until confirmed.
